_help: Enemies, in pixels, seconds and hit points. Enemies move freely but ATTACK ON THE BEAT: a wind-up starts on one beat and strikes on a later one, so the music tells you when to dodge or parry. 'olives' is how many olives it drops when beaten. A guardian with a 'defeat_flag' raises that flag when beaten and never comes back.

scorpion._note: Low to the ground: a standing swing passes over it. Crouch (hold Down) and strike.

colchis_bull.name: The Colchis Bull
colchis_bull._note: A bronze machine from Hephaestus's forge, or a copy of one. Its armoured front shrugs off the club: dodge its charge, strike its back, or hit it while it's dazed against a wall.
